---
title: "quarto-index demo"
# Smart typography is off so the escaping probes below reach the filter as
# the ASCII characters they are written as. With Quarto's default `smart`,
# a typed `"` becomes a curly quote in the document text, and the index
# entry derived from a visible term correctly follows the rendered text —
# which would leave makeindex's quote character unexercised here.
from: markdown-smart
filters:
  - index
---

# Supported forms

The four supported span forms, each exercised at least once.

**Visible term.** The word [pandoc]{.index} is indexed by its own text.
Marking [pandoc]{.index} again, and a third time [pandoc]{.index}, adds
further locators to the same entry.

**Custom entry.** This [phrase]{.index entry="Custom Entry"} stays visible
but indexes under a different term.

**Sub-entries.** A [nested term]{.index entry="Top!Middle!Leaf"} indexes
three levels deep.

**Invisible entry.** This sentence carries a mark with no visible
text.[]{.index entry="Ghost!Sub"}

# Level syntax probes

A literal exclamation mark is written `!!`.

Leading: [lead]{.index entry="!!Bang leads"}.
Medial: [mid]{.index entry="Wow!!Really"}.
Trailing: [trail]{.index entry="Trail bang!!"}.
Odd run: [odd]{.index entry="A!!!B"}.
Backslash level: [bslash]{.index entry="\\"}.
Old spelling: [old]{.index entry="Alpha\!Beta"}.
Empty level: [empty]{.index entry="A!!B!"}.
Too deep: [deep]{.index entry="One!Two!Three!Four!Five!"}.

# Escaping probes

Every character of `% & # _ { } \ ~ ^ $ @ | ! "` across visible terms. These
are kept short so each fits one line of the two-column printed index:
[pct % amp & hash #]{.index}, [us \_ brace \{ \}]{.index},
[bs \\ tilde \~ caret \^]{.index}, [dollar \$ at @ bar \|]{.index}, and
[bang ! quote "]{.index}.

The same characters in an `entry=` level:
[entry specials]{.index entry="Specials % & # _ { } \\ ~ ^ $ @ | !! \" < >"}.

Leading and trailing specials in visible terms:
[\{Braced\}]{.index} and [\~tilde dollar\$]{.index}.

Angle brackets, which Pandoc's own LaTeX writer escapes:
[less \< more \>]{.index}.

Non-ASCII, which IP2 requires to appear correctly in the index:
[café naïve]{.index} and [Grüße]{.index entry="Grüße!Straße"}.
